cross_reference_limit: overall scheme outcome ranking shown separately from within-reference comparisons; not same-command pure-policy causality or hardware certification
method: ascending average ranks per available informative metric; cost percentile=100*(rank-1)/(n-1); final recommendation score=100-mean(cost percentiles); all variable metrics equal weight. Exact and floating-roundoff ties get average rank; constant metrics retained but cannot change the order.
pareto_role: supplemental sensitivity only; not a prerequisite or prior score tier
supersedes: Pareto-only ranking_contract.method in immutable plan.json; finite evaluation contracts and budgets unchanged
user_decision: 等权百分位总分（推荐，可给明确先后；每项指标权重相同）
